mathematical_checks.reason: The proof rewrites to the complete ZMod c sum and uses the bijection u -> -u on every residue. IsUnit u iff IsUnit (-u); nonunit terms remain zero. For unit u, (-u)^-1 = -(u^-1), and the two coefficient negations cancel after the variable substitution. No conjugation or omitted residue class is used.

The actual completed kernel includes c=1 whenever it lies in Ioc 0 (floor (10*C)). z=0 is also harmless: the coprime gate then permits only c=1.

frequency at -p keeps the Fourier transform evaluated at -(M/c)*p. Only the Kloosterman sign chart changes to S(p*inverseResidue(c,z), -(a*y); c).
